parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Name, email, or phone fragment (2 to 100 characters)

status.description: invited: new pending Client; invitation_resent: the email already had a pending invitation and received a fresh link; verification_pending: the email belongs to a pending self-registration and received a fresh verification link

pendingExpiresAt.description: When the pending invitation is removed unless activated

activationExpiresAt.description: Expiry of the current activation link

cancellable.description: False once the Client holds a Subscription, Payment, or Booking

credential.description: Opaque bearer credential returned only once

referralCode.description: Referral code of the Client who invited this person

amountDueCentavos.description: Amount to transfer in BOB centavos

reservedCentavos.description: Credit held for a Payment under review

qrImageUrl.description: Backend route serving the studio QR image

receiptUrl.description: Authenticated backend route streaming the receipt while it is retained

actionable.description: Whether the signed-in Staff Member may cancel, reschedule, or leave this item

amountDueCentavos.description: Cash to collect in BOB centavos

branchId.description: Branch where the cash was collected

checksum.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 checksum of the declared bytes

uploadUrl.description: Where to PUT the declared bytes before finalizing

mediaType.description: Verified media type once the worker has processed the bytes
